correctness.rationale: Feynman–Kac with resetting yields piecewise ODE Df″−(r+s+v 1_{x>a})f+rf(a)=0, f(0)=1 and bounded infinity. Occupation-density delta potential imposes interface jump D(f′(a+)−f′(a−))=u f(a). Explicit cosh/sinh left solution and decaying right solution give the quoted trivariate Laplace transform for all s,u,v≥0, not just marginals. At s=0 it equals [1+A(u+Φ(v))]⁻¹ with A=sinh(a√(r/D))/√(Dr), Φ(v)=√D v/√(r+v); its Lévy density is positive and integrable, hence independent Exp-time stopped subordinator. Differentiating gives conditional moments and exact increasing correlation. Independent exact algebra checked correlation at nine parameter combinations; inspected finite-difference program tests PDE consistency. Local time normalization explicitly occupation-density, not semimartingale local time.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate but do not replace the unrestricted argument.
